entities.summary: Nattawut Jantaweemol, later Muangchai Jantaweemol, known professionally as Muangchai Kittikasem, is a Thai former professional boxer who competed between 1988 and 1999. He is the first Thai to be a world champion in two weight classes, having held the International Boxing Federation (IBF) junior-flyweight title from 1989 to 1990 and the World Boxing Council (WBC) flyweight title from 1991 to 1992.
